scans.result.auth_changed.fix: The finding is unchanged. Verify it by hand, or retest with a check that sends the needed access.
scans.result.auth_changed.text: The endpoint now asks for authentication, so the check could not see the content it looks for.
scans.result.blocked.fix: The finding is unchanged. Allow the sensor through the firewall or CDN, or retest later.
scans.result.blocked.text: The endpoint answered with a block, a CDN page or a rate limit instead of the application's own response.
scans.result.check_uncalibrated.fix: Run the check against a case where the issue is known to be present, so it is calibrated.
scans.result.check_uncalibrated.text: The check has not matched this finding yet, so a missing match does not prove a fix.
scans.result.endpoint_mismatch.fix: Add a retest check pinned to the exact URL of the finding.
scans.result.endpoint_mismatch.text: The check ran but did not request this finding's own endpoint, so it proves nothing about it.
scans.result.error.fix: The finding is unchanged. Verify it by hand, or retest after the sensor is updated.
scans.result.error.text: The tool could not run this check.
scans.result.excluded_by_policy.fix: The finding is unchanged. Verify it by hand or in a planned test window.
scans.result.excluded_by_policy.text: The sensor's safety policy does not run checks of this class for a retest.
scans.result.matched_elsewhere.fix: The finding stays as it is. The other paths are listed in the retest reason; consider reporting them as their own finding.
scans.result.matched_elsewhere.text: The finding's own endpoint no longer matches, but the check matched at another path of the same target.
scans.result.no_endpoint_proof.fix: Add a retest check pinned to the exact URL of the finding, then retest.
scans.result.no_endpoint_proof.text: The check ran, but nothing shows it requested this finding's endpoint, so a missing match proves nothing.
scans.result.no_result.fix: Retest again. If it repeats, check the sensor and the run log.
scans.result.no_result.text: The tool finished but sent no result for this check.
scans.result.no_verdict.fix: Retest again. If it repeats, check the sensor and the run log.
scans.result.no_verdict.text: The tool ended without a verdict for this finding.
scans.result.server_error.fix: The finding is unchanged. Retest when the application is healthy.
scans.result.server_error.text: The endpoint answered with a server error, so the check could not tell whether the issue is still there.
scans.result.template_changed.fix: The finding is unchanged. Verify it by hand, or attach a check that matches the original one.
scans.result.template_changed.text: The check was changed since the finding was raised, so its result is not comparable.
scans.result.template_not_found.fix: Update the sensor's templates (or the sensor itself), then retest.
scans.result.template_not_found.text: The sensor does not have this check installed, so it could not be run.
scans.result.unknown.fix: The finding is unchanged. Retest, or verify it by hand.
scans.result.unknown.text: The check ran but reached no conclusion about this finding.
scans.result.unreachable.fix: The finding is unchanged. Check that the target is up and reachable from the sensor, then retest.
scans.result.unreachable.text: The sensor could not reach the target, so the check could not tell whether the issue is still there.
